standard_prerequisites.name: Exterior powers of a finite locally free module and of its quotients
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The standard filtration on exterior powers induced by a two step filtration of the module, whose subquotients are exterior powers of the sub and of the quotient tensored with exterior powers of the other
standard_prerequisites.use: Computes the class of the exterior power of the middle term of a short exact sequence in terms of the exterior powers of the outer terms.

standard_prerequisites.name: Well definedness of a multiplicative map out of a Grothendieck group
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The construction of the Grothendieck group of vector bundles through generators and relations, showing that a rule additive in short exact sequences descends to a ring homomorphism
standard_prerequisites.use: Descends the power series construction to the Grothendieck group and identifies the coefficients as the desired operations.

core_obligations: The power series construction (proof lines 4527-4544): in the ring of power series over the Grothendieck group, associate to a finite locally free module the series whose coefficients are the classes of its exterior powers; the claim is multiplicativity in short exact sequences, which descends the series to a map from the Grothendieck group converting addition into multiplication, and its coefficients are the desired operators.

Multiplicativity in short exact sequences (proof lines 4544-4572): viewing the short exact sequence as a two step filtration on the middle term gives an induced filtration with one more step on each exterior power, with subquotients the tensor products of the exterior powers of the sub and of the quotient; taking classes and collecting terms gives the multiplicativity, which follows by elementary algebra.
proof_roadmap: Associate to each module the power series of its exterior powers.
Prove multiplicativity in short exact sequences via the induced filtration.
Descend to the Grothendieck group and read off the operators.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the exterior power operations on finite locally free modules extend to maps on the Grothendieck group of vector bundles compatible with pullbacks (statement lines 4523-4530). The proof (proof lines 4531-4572) constructs a power series with coefficients the classes of exterior powers, proves its multiplicativity in short exact sequences using the induced filtration, and descends it to the Grothendieck group. H2: a complete standard construction in two steps.
